subject.title: Memory system: Cannot delete stale memories, conflicting entries persist

question: Should this remain a narrow LanceDB recall-to-forget selector issue, or should it be folded into the broader memory lifecycle contract tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42650?
rationale: Current source proves a deletion handoff gap, but choosing UUID-in-recall, numeric indexes, query fallback, or replacement/deprecation semantics is a memory API and safety decision automation should not settle.

options.title: Keep Narrow Selector Open
options.body: Preserve this issue for a focused model-visible recall deletion selector while leaving automatic replacement and tombstone semantics to the broader lifecycle tracker.

options.title: Fold Into Lifecycle MVP
options.body: Close this as covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42650 after explicitly preserving the concrete repro there.

options.title: Sponsor Replacement Semantics
options.body: Use this issue to define and implement supersede/tombstone/conflict behavior directly in memory-lancedb, accepting a broader product/API change.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Selector Open
recommendation.body: Preserve this issue for a focused model-visible recall deletion selector while leaving automatic replacement and tombstone semantics to the broader lifecycle tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory storage/provenance work is closest to the durable lifecycle contract decision.
